representations.name: absolute sparse-cell capacity
representations.new_information: tracks the absolute harmonic mass available in a low-density congruence cell instead of dividing by its eventual deletion density
representations.first_test: derive an exact finite-window formula for one periodic cell and compare it with the relative amplifier

representations.name: positive-background binary reservoir
representations.new_information: keeps all even integers while a binary tower carves the odd cell down to one residue modulo Q
representations.first_test: construct a symbolic family of pairwise target-isolated layers and certify its ambient density and amplification

representations.name: logarithmic-window ledger
representations.new_information: records the logarithmic span log(v/u), not only the endpoint or number of targets, for each onset block
representations.first_test: prove that a bounded-ratio window has vanishing normalised capacity regardless of congruence structure

representations.name: scale-span necessity certificate
representations.new_information: turns nonvanishing oscillation into a necessary lower bound on the logarithmic span and absolute capacity of infinitely many blocks
representations.first_test: replay concatenated finite champions after exact dilution by earlier logarithmic time

representations.name: nested-cell reuse tree
representations.new_information: represents repeated attacks as a tree whose nodes are congruence cells and whose mass is their periodic density
representations.first_test: test whether a path or antichain can reuse cell mass without an equal density payment

representations.name: Carleson density-loss measure
representations.new_information: places the telescoping losses e_i on logarithmic onset scale and asks for a Carleson embedding bound for delayed periodic layers
representations.first_test: falsify candidate box inequalities on exact binary-reservoir blocks

representations.name: CRT target-incidence graph
representations.new_information: retains divisibility relations n_i divides t_j-a_i that determine whether chosen transient targets remain isolated
representations.first_test: verify an interval construction in which no selected modulus divides another target offset

representations.name: Abel discrepancy transform
representations.new_information: expresses harmonic mass through counting-function discrepancy uniformly between onset and cutoff
representations.first_test: separate the density main term from the pre-mixing error and locate the exact unsummed term

representations.name: age-period entropy potential
representations.new_information: charges a layer according to both log(x/n_i) and the unresolved lcm period of its conditional increment
representations.first_test: check whether nested layers can recycle the same period entropy at multiple onsets

representations.name: adversarial multiscale optimiser
representations.new_information: searches directly for repeated blocks that maximise absolute normalised oscillation under a fixed positive-density reservoir
representations.first_test: run guarded exact and relaxed optimisers with scale-span and density-loss accounting
